name: summary-strip
title: SummaryStrip
description: Key facts in one bordered row: a muted label, mono values and 1px vertical separators, wrapping on narrow screens. Used for the Behavior "Saved" strip, the Service and Agent dispatcher summaries and the Sources schedule strip.

a11y.pattern: A <div> (role="note" when it sums up the page state) holding text spans; the separators are aria-hidden
keyboard: Reaches links or buttons placed in the strip
aria: The separators are decorative (aria-hidden); the words and their order carry the meaning
role="note" (optional) with an aria-label when the strip is a summary of the form below it
a11y.notes: Static item. Muted labels and secondary mono values keep 4.5:1 on --surface, and on --canvas for variant="canvas", in both themes. The variant only changes the look.
